Dropseed Native Plant Nursery.name: Dropseed Native Plant Nursery
Dropseed Native Plant Nursery.specialty: KY, IN and OH natives grown from local strains: wildflowers, ferns, grasses, trees, shrubs and seed
Dropseed Native Plant Nursery.notes: Owner Margaret Shea (25+ years in ecology). 1205 S Buckeye Ln, Goshen KY. Retail hours in spring and fall (fall 2026: Fri–Sat 9am–4pm, Sept 4–Oct 31), and open by appointment year round. Ships seeds and potted plants to KY, OH, TN, MO, IN, IL, PA, VA, WV and MI. Does not ship trees or shrubs.

Ironweed Native Plant Nursery.name: Ironweed Native Plant Nursery
Ironweed Native Plant Nursery.specialty: Natives grown from Kentucky sources; plants for caterpillars and hummingbirds
Ironweed Native Plant Nursery.notes: Woman- and minority-owned Kentucky nursery at 400 Waddy Road. In the cool season, visits are by appointment; text ahead. Regular hours return in March. It does not ship to Arizona, California, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, New Mexico, Oregon, Utah, Washington, Wyoming, Texas, North Dakota, South Dakota, Nebraska, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, Vermont, Alaska, Hawaii or Canada. Orders need at least 8 plants, shipping is free, and orders go out early in the week. All sales final.

Roundstone Native Seed.name: Roundstone Native Seed
Roundstone Native Seed.specialty: Bulk native grass & wildflower seed and custom restoration mixes (not a container nursery)
Roundstone Native Seed.notes: Restoration-scale seed producer; also custom packaging, consulting, and seed cleaning. Some live seedling plugs. Online cart takes Visa/MC/Amex; $5.00 minimum per line item, and custom plug orders start at 2,000 plugs per species.

Direct Native Plants.name: Direct Native Plants
Direct Native Plants.notes: Retail arm of American Native Plants wholesale. Ships by FedEx to the lower 48 states and DC, from Maryland for customers east of Ohio and from Illinois for those west of West Virginia. No pickup offered.

Camp Creek Native Plants.name: Camp Creek Native Plants
Camp Creek Native Plants.specialty: Southeast natives & pollinator species; contract growing
Camp Creek Native Plants.notes: 921 Sam T. Barkley Dr., New Albany, MS; Mon–Sat 9–4, closed Sunday. Ships every Monday by UPS. Its site does not say which states it ships to. 1- and 3-gallon sizes are sold in the store only.

Prairie Moon Nursery.name: Prairie Moon Nursery
Prairie Moon Nursery.specialty: 700+ native species as seed, bare-root & plugs
Prairie Moon Nursery.notes: Online and phone orders only; no storefront. Plants cannot ship outside the contiguous US or to California; seed ships year-round, plants only in spring and fall.

Izel Native Plants.name: Izel Native Plants
Izel Native Plants.specialty: Online marketplace selling 800+ native species and varieties from wholesale growers
Izel Native Plants.notes: An online marketplace selling plants from several wholesale growers, with no order minimum. Free shipping. Its site can filter to Kentucky natives.

Ancient Roots Native Nursery.name: Ancient Roots Native Nursery
Ancient Roots Native Nursery.specialty: Native trees, shrubs & perennials for the Ohio Valley
Ancient Roots Native Nursery.notes: 5801 Hwy 66, Poseyville, IN. Thu–Fri 12–4 and Sat 9–12 CST, Mon–Wed by appointment. Online catalogue with prices. Also ships, but its site does not say which states it ships to.

Talbott Nursery.name: Talbott Nursery
Talbott Nursery.specialty: Native azaleas & rhododendrons (incl. R. maximum); also orchids & edibles
Talbott Nursery.notes: Texas nursery, 40+ years, at 1250 E. Gibson St., Jasper. Call Tue–Sat 10–4 to arrange a visit. Ships Mon–Wed and sometimes Sat, by UPS or USPS Priority (its site names both). Ships beyond the lower 48 states.

Louisville Native Plant Nursery.name: Louisville Native Plant Nursery
Louisville Native Plant Nursery.specialty: Native perennials, grasses, ferns and vines, with a focus on local strains
Louisville Native Plant Nursery.notes: Run by one person, Tyler Lloyd. Order by Friday noon and pick up on Saturday, 9 AM–1 PM. No shopping on site and no shipping. Closed for the season; reopens April 2027.

Prairie Nursery.name: Prairie Nursery
Prairie Nursery.specialty: Native wildflowers, grasses, sedges, ferns & shrubs; plants and seed
Prairie Nursery.notes: Wisconsin native-plant specialist since the 1970s. Mail order only; its only address is a P.O. Box. Ships the contiguous US except Idaho, Oregon and Utah, which it attributes to agricultural restrictions. Fall 2026 plant sales have ended; its site says to check back in December for spring. Seed ships year-round.

High Country Gardens.name: High Country Gardens
High Country Gardens.specialty: Native and drought-tolerant perennials, grasses and shrubs
High Country Gardens.notes: Ships plants to the lower 48 states.

Las Pilitas Nursery.name: Las Pilitas Nursery
Las Pilitas Nursery.notes: Ships plants to Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Utah and Washington.

Native Gardeners.name: Native Gardeners
Native Gardeners.specialty: Texas native plants, with a list for each Texas region, including the South Texas Plains, Edwards Plateau and Trans-Pecos
Native Gardeners.notes: Nursery in Arlington, Texas, at 3300 W Division St, open daily 9am to 4pm. Ships live plants in pots from 4 inches to 25 gallons. Orders ship within 7 to 10 business days. Its site does not say which states it ships to, so only Texas is listed.

Nature Hills.name: Nature Hills
Nature Hills.specialty: Trees, shrubs and perennials, including a native plant list by state
Nature Hills.notes: Ships plants to the lower 48 states except Idaho and Montana.

Garden for Wildlife.name: Garden for Wildlife
Garden for Wildlife.specialty: Native wildflowers, grasses, shrubs and trees
Garden for Wildlife.notes: Mail order only, to the lower 48 states. Some plants ship only to certain states, and the shop asks for your ZIP code before you buy one. Wildflowers and grasses come in sets of 3, 6 or 12 plants of one species. Shrubs and trees come in packs of 1, 2 or 4.
